newsitem.title: TOGO: Zaire's Mobutu rests in Togo on flight into exile.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu rests in Togo on flight into exile.

text.p: Zaire's ousted president, Mobutu Sese Seko, rested in Togo on Monday after leaving his jungle palace in his home region of Gbadolite, a security source said.
The veteran strongman, who is fighting cancer, arrived on Sunday and was expected to fly on in due course, most likely to Morocco, the source added.
Mobutu, 66, fled his capital Kinshasa on Friday, one day before Laurent Kabila's rebels marched in and proclaimed victory in their seven-month civil war. Mobutu had ruled since 1965.
